for j in range(20):

    R=np.column_stack([z]+[np.maximum(z-k,0) for k in ks[j]])

starts=np.cumsum([1]+dims).tolist()

def basis(X):
    Fs=[]
    for j in range(20):
        z=X[:,j]
        R=np.column_stack([z]+[np.maximum(z-k,0) for k in ks[j]])
        Fs.append((R-means[j])@transforms[j])
    A=np.empty((len(X),pstarts[-1]))
    A[:,0]=1
    for j in range(20): A[:,starts[j]:starts[j+1]]=Fs[j]
    for q,(i,j) in enumerate(pairs):
        A[:,pstarts[q]:pstarts[q+1]]=(Fs[i][:,:,None]*Fs[j][:,None,:]).reshape(len(X),-1)
    return A
